correctness.rationale: The vvᵀ cone has |X|=(q^m+1)/2 and averaged characters equal (1+Σ_{v∈F_q^m}phase(v))/(q^m+1). Independent bilinear character sums yield u=(1+q^{m-1})/N for equal/intersecting edge frequencies and v=(1+q^{m-2})/N for disjoint edges. Orthogonal edge-frequency differences give q^{m-1}(q-1)/N; unsigned complete-graph incidence diagonalization IᵀI=2I+A(J(m,2)) gives the star and cycle eigenvalues with multiplicities m-1 and E-m; the constant couples to the all-edges line in exact 2x2 block K. Positive-definiteness also follows by restricting vectors v to supports size≤2 and Fourier character independence. Exact symbolic determinant sign factor m(q-2)+4+q^{m-2}(4(q²-q+1)-m) determines the sole lower mode switch at m=4(q²-q+1)+1; fixed q, L+~(q-1)m²/(2q²), L-~4(q-1)/m. Independently assembled q=3,m=4 Fourier Gram and eigenvalues to numerical tolerance 2.7e-15 and derived symbolic factor and q=3,5,7,9,11 sign boundaries.
